<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;">

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><a name="PartI_110101"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">PART I</font></b></a></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-size:10.0pt;margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><a name="Item1_Business_110106"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">ITEM
1.</font></b></a><b><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;font-weight:bold;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font></b><b><font style="font-weight:bold;">BUSINESS</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">General Overview</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We are the world&#146;s largest franchisee of TGI Friday&#146;s
restaurants, currently owning 52 TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants.&#160; In addition, we own and operate 13 Bamboo
Club &#147;Asian Bistro&#148; restaurants. We also own four Redfish Seafood Grill and Bar
restaurants and operate an Alice Cooper&#146;stown restaurant in Cleveland, Ohio,
pursuant to a license agreement with Celebrity Restaurants, L.L.C., the owner
of the exclusive rights to operate Alice Cooper&#146;stown restaurants. Our sales in
2004 were approximately $224 million, and we operate in 14 states.</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants are full-service, casual dining
establishments featuring a wide selection of freshly prepared, popular foods
and beverages served by well-trained, friendly employees in relaxed
settings.&#160; Bamboo Club &#147;Asian Bistro&#148;
restaurants are full-service, casual plus restaurants that feature an extensive
and diverse menu of innovative and tantalizing Pacific Rim cuisine.&#160; Redfish Seafood Grill and Bar restaurants are
full-service, casual dining restaurants that feature a broad selection of New
Orleans style fresh seafood, Creole and seafood cuisine, and traditional
southern dishes, as well as a &#147;Voodoo&#148; style lounge, all under one roof.&#160; Alice Cooper&#146;stown restaurants are rock and
roll and sports themed and feature a connection to the music celebrity Alice
Cooper.</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We own the exclusive rights to
develop additional TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants in Southern California, Nevada,
Arizona, New Mexico, and El Paso, Texas and own TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants in the
metropolitan areas of Kansas City, Kansas, and Kansas City, Missouri. We own
the Bamboo Club and Redfish brands.&#160; Our
strategy is to:</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-size:10.0pt;margin:0in 0in .0001pt .75in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="3" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#149;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font>Capitalize on the
brand-name recognition and goodwill associated with TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants;</p>

<p style="font-size:10.0pt;margin:0in 0in .0001pt .75in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="3" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#149;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font>Expand our restaurant
operations through:</p>

<p style="font-size:10.0pt;margin:0in 0in .0001pt 1.0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="3" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#149;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font>the development of an
additional 16 TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants by 2009 in our existing development
territories,</p>

<p style="font-size:10.0pt;margin:0in 0in .0001pt 1.0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="3" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#149;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font>the limited development
of additional Bamboo Club restaurants in certain key markets in&#160; the United States when our development
capital allows, and</p>

<p style="font-size:10.0pt;margin:0in 0in .0001pt 1.0in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="3" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#149;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font>the possible
acquisition or development of restaurants operating under other restaurant
concepts; and</p>

<p style="font-size:10.0pt;margin:0in 0in .0001pt .75in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="3" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#149;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font>Improve our
profitability by continuing to enhance the dining experience of our guests and
improving operating efficiency at all of our restaurant brands;</p>

<p style="font-size:10.0pt;margin:0in 0in .0001pt .75in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="3" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#149;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font>Reduce our long-term
debt; and</p>

<p style="font-size:10.0pt;margin:0in 0in .0001pt .75in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="3" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#149;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font>Sell non-core assets or
restaurants in non-core markets.</p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .75in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We may explore opportunities to franchise Bamboo Club
and Redfish concepts to third parties in the future.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We were incorporated in December&nbsp;1988.&#160; On July&nbsp;15, 2004, we changed our name
from Main Street and Main Incorporated to Main Street Restaurant Group, Inc. We
maintain our principal executive offices at 5050 North 40th Street, Suite 200,
Phoenix, Arizona 85018, and our telephone number is (602) 852-9000.&#160; Our website is located at
www.mainandmain.com. Through our website, we make available free of charge our
annual report on Form 10-K, our quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, our current
reports on </font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">1</font></p>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;">

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Form 8-K, our proxy statements, and any
amendments to those reports filed or furnished pursuant to Section&nbsp;13(a)
or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.&#160; These reports are available as soon as
reasonably practicable after we electronically file those reports with the

also post on our website the charters of our Audit Committee, Compensation

regulations.&#160; These documents are also
available in print to any stockholder requesting a copy from our corporate
secretary at our principal executive offices.&#160;
As used in this Report, the terms &#147;we,&#148; &#147;our,&#148; &#147;us,&#148; the&#160; &#147;Company&#148;, our company, and &#147;Main Street&#148;
refers to Main Street Restaurant Group, Inc. and its subsidiaries and operating
divisions.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">Operations</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">The TGI Friday&#146;s Concept</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The TGI Friday&#146;s concept is
franchised by TGI Friday&#146;s Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Carlson
Restaurants Worldwide, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Carlson Companies
Inc., which is a diversified company with business interests in the restaurant
and hospitality industries.&#160; The first
TGI Friday&#146;s restaurant was opened in 1965 in New York City.&#160; TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. and its predecessors have
conducted a business since 1972 that is substantially similar to the business
currently conducted by its franchisees.&#160; As
of December&nbsp;27, 2004, TGI Friday&#146;s Inc., had 267 franchisor-operated and
492 franchised TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants operating worldwide.&#160; On December&nbsp;27, 2004, TGI Friday&#146;s Inc.
owned 53,016 shares, or approximately 0.036%, of our outstanding common stock.&#160; Holders of our common stock do not have any
financial interest in TGI Friday&#146;s Inc., and TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. has no
responsibility for the contents of this report.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants are
full-service, casual dining establishments featuring a wide selection of
high-quality, freshly prepared popular foods and beverages, including a number
of innovative and distinctive menu items, such as menu items featuring &#147;Jack
Daniel&#146;s&#148; sauces.&#160;&#160;&#160; The restaurants
feature quick, efficient, and friendly table service designed to minimize
customer-waiting time and facilitate table turnover.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#160;Our restaurants generally are open seven days
a week between the hours of approximately 11:00 a.m. and 1:00 a.m.&#160; We have three locations that have curbside
service in Chandler, Arizona, our Desert Ridge location (North Phoenix,
Arizona), and Ontario, California. We believe that the design and operational
consistency of all TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants enable us to benefit significantly
from the name recognition and goodwill associated with TGI Friday&#146;s
restaurants.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">The TGI Friday&#146;s System</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants are
developed and operated pursuant to a specified system.&#160; TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. maintains detailed
standards, specifications, procedures, and operating policies to facilitate the
success and consistency of all TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants.&#160; To ensure that the highest degree of quality
and service is maintained, each franchisee of TGI Friday&#146;s Inc., including our
company, must operate each TGI Friday&#146;s restaurant in strict conformity with
these methods, standards, and specifications.&#160;
The TGI Friday&#146;s system includes:</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-size:10.0pt;margin:0in 0in .0001pt .75in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="3" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#149;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font>distinctive exterior
and interior design, decor, color scheme, and furnishings;</p>

<p style="font-size:10.0pt;margin:0in 0in .0001pt .75in;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="3" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:12.0pt;">&#149;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font>uniform specifications,
procedures for operations, formal training, and standardized menus featuring
special recipes and menu items;</p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We estimate that our total
cost of opening a new TGI Friday&#146;s restaurant currently ranges from $2,475,000
to $2,825,000, exclusive of annual operating expenses and assuming that we
obtain the underlying real estate under a lease arrangement.&#160; These costs include approximately (a)
$1,650,000 to $2,000,000 for building, improvements, and permits, including
liquor licenses, (b) $600,000 for furniture, fixtures, and equipment, (c)
$175,000 in pre-opening expenses, including hiring expenses, wages for managers
and hourly employees, and supplies, and (d) $50,000 for the initial franchise
fee.&#160; Actual costs, however, may vary
significantly depending upon a variety of factors, including the site and size
of the restaurant and conditions in the local real estate and employment
markets.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">The Bamboo Club &#147;Asian Bistro&#148; Concept</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Bamboo Club &#147;Asian Bistro&#148; restaurants are
full-service, casual plus restaurants that feature an extensive and diverse
menu of innovative and tantalizing Pacific Rim cuisine.&#160; Bamboo Club restaurants use fresh ingredients
and premium herbs and spices in creative combinations to serve high-quality
food and beverages that deliver a unique combination of delicious taste,
eye-appealing color, appetizing aroma, and delightful texture.&#160; The Bamboo Club concept has been designed to
deliver a consistent and enjoyable dining experience to each guest in an
elegant, casual/plus atmosphere.&#160; The
restaurants feature a modern d&#233;cor that provides a dramatic yet comfortable
impression, with food and beverages prepared and served by a highly trained and
skilled staff.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Bamboo Club restaurants are open for lunch and
dinner, with hours from 11:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. Monday through Thursday, 11:00
a.m. to midnight on Friday and Saturday, and 11:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. on
Sunday.&#160; The kitchen remains open until
11:00 p.m. Monday through Thursday, until midnight on Friday and Saturday to
accommodate guests who prefer to dine late, and until 10:00 p.m. on
Sunday.&#160; Bamboo Club restaurants take
reservations and can serve large parties or groups.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">Menu</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Bamboo Club restaurants feature a menu of more than
60 items inspired by the diverse and exotic cuisines found in locations such as
Bangkok, Canton, Singapore, Seoul, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Hawaii, Saigon,
Thailand, Japan and other Pacific Rim cities and provinces.&#160; Each Bamboo Club restaurant also features a
full-service bar that serves a variety of popular drinks and liquors, such as
martinis and tropical drinks, as well as traditional mixed beverages, fine
wines, and a wide selection of popular Asian and domestic beers.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

approximately 4%-5% of total revenue.&#160; In

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The 13 Bamboo Club restaurants are located in
high-traffic retail shopping environments.&#160;

Each of these restaurants features indoor seating and bar area seating
for a total of approximately 240 guests, which does not include outdoor patio
seating at some locations.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Bamboo Club &#147;Asian Bistro&#148; restaurants have

professional, friendly, highly skilled, and knowledgeable about the restaurant&#146;s
cuisine and menu selections.&#160; Servers are
trained to make suggestions or recommendations for new or different menu items
or combinations that patrons might try, which helps each guest to enjoy a
memorable dining experience.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We originally acquired two
operating Bamboo Club restaurants in Phoenix and Scottsdale, Arizona, and since
have opened a total of 11 Bamboo Club restaurants, one each in Wellington,
Tampa, and Aventura, Florida; one each in Tempe, Tucson, and Desert Ridge
(North Phoenix), Arizona; one in Newport, Kentucky; one in King of Prussia,
Pennsylvania; one in Novi (Detroit), Michigan; one in Raleigh/Durham, North
Carolina; and one which opened in 2004, in Fairfax, Virginia.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">Construction Economics</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">After opening 11 mall-based Bamboo Club restaurants, our
total cost of opening a new mall-based location ranges between $1,350,000 and
$2,150,000, exclusive of annual operating expenses.&#160; These costs include approximately (a)
$600,000 to $1,300,000, net of a reduction for landlord&#146;s contribution, for
building improvements and permits, including liquor licenses, (b) $600,000 to
$650,000 for furniture, fixtures, and equipment, and (c) $150,000 to $200,000
in pre-opening expenses, including hiring expenses, wages for managers and
hourly employees, and supplies.&#160;&#160; Our total
cost of opening our first free-standing Bamboo Club was approximately
$3,000,000, exclusive of annual operating expenses. These costs included
approximately (a) $2,250,000 for building improvements and permits, including
liquor licenses, (b) $610,000 for furniture, fixtures, and equipment, and (c)
$140,000 in pre-opening expenses, including hiring expenses, wages for managers
and hourly employees, and supplies. These costs were affected by the following
factors: (i) this was our first free-standing unit and therefore we had
increased design and architects fees, (ii) the site has a balcony for seating,
(iii) pre-opening expenses were reduced by virtue of the location being in
Phoenix where our company is headquartered, and (iv) delay related costs associated
with the construction of this project.</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Our Redfish Seafood Grill and Bar
Restaurants</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Redfish Seafood Grill and Bar
restaurants are full-service, casual dining restaurants that feature a broad
selection of seafood, steaks, and French Quarter cuisine.&#160; Our four restaurants offer unique, freshly
prepared food that is served quickly and efficiently in a fun-filled New
Orleans atmosphere.&#160; Each Redfish
restaurant&#146;s Voodoo lounge features a unique atmosphere decorated with an
eclectic collection of authentic New Orleans artifacts, signs, and
antiques.&#160; Some locations have local
bands and, occasionally, national touring acts present live rhythm and blues
music on weekends.&#160; Redfish restaurants
are open for lunch and dinner seven days a week. Hours of operation are usually
from 11:00 a.m. until midnight Monday through Thursday and 11:00 a.m. until
1:00 a.m. on weekends.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">Menu</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We have developed a menu of
more than 65 items for our Redfish restaurants.&#160;
Signature dishes include blackened redfish, Bourbon Street jambalaya,
crab stuffed salmon, and shrimp brochette.&#160;
The</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">5</font></p>

<div>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">menu also features a selection of appetizers,
including Looziana egg rolls, Maryland-style crab cakes, Captain Morgan&#174; ribs
and chicken, and crab and artichoke dip.&#160;
Our Redfish menu also features a variety of fresh seafood, steaks, ribs,
pastas, fresh seasonal salads, sandwiches, and tempting desserts, such as
bananas foster, chocolate bread pudding, and our signature key lime pie.&#160; The spacious Voodoo lounge offers a wide
selection of the finest beers on tap, a full wine list, and an extensive
specialty drink list.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Menu prices range from $7 to
$20 for an entr&#233;e and $5 to $10 for salads and appetizers.&#160; Alcohol sales currently account for approximately
36% of total revenue.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">Restaurant Layout</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We developed the Redfish
restaurant layout to provide a refined southern roadhouse atmosphere.&#160; Each of our Redfish restaurants is decorated
with nostalgic mementos of the South, together with decorative elements that
are derived from the individual restaurant&#146;s locale.&#160; The d&#233;cor generally creates a tribute to the
legends of American music that created the blues, as well as to the regions
that developed the classic Creole, Cajun, and American cuisine served in our
Redfish restaurants.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Most of our Redfish
restaurants are located in high-traffic urban office environments.&#160; These restaurants contain between 6,000 and
7,300 square feet of space and average approximately 7,000 square feet.&#160; Our Redfish restaurants contain an average of
60 dining tables, seating an average of 250 guests, and a bar area seating an
average of approximately 25 additional guests.&#160;
We have developed a prototype for use in developing Redfish restaurants
in the future.&#160; We constructed two
restaurants using this prototype in Scottsdale and Chandler, Arizona. We
developed this prototype in order to standardize the construction process and
to reduce costs. However, we do not currently plan to build any new Redfish
restaurants in the foreseeable future.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">Construction Economics</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We estimate that our total
cost of opening a new Redfish restaurant currently ranges from $2,400,000 to
$2,600,000, exclusive of annual operating expenses and assuming that we obtain
the underlying real estate under a lease arrangement.&#160; These costs include approximately (a)
$1,650,000 to $1,850,000 for building, improvements, and permits, including
liquor licenses, (b) $600,000 for furniture, fixtures, and equipment, and (c)
$150,000 in pre-opening expenses, including hiring expenses, wages for managers
and hourly employees, and supplies.&#160;
Actual costs, however, may vary significantly depending upon a variety
of factors, including the site and size of the restaurant and conditions in the
local real estate and employment markets.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:0in;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Our Alice Cooper&#146;stown Restaurant</font></b></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:0in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Alice Cooper&#146;stown concept
was developed by Celebrity Restaurants, L.L.C. and is rock and roll and sports
themed, featuring a connection to Alice Cooper. We own no interest in Celebrity
Restaurants, L.L.C., and it owns no interest in us. Celebrity Restaurants
operates one Alice Cooper&#146;stown restaurant, which opened in December&nbsp;1998
in Phoenix, Arizona.&#160; Our Alice Cooper&#146;stown
restaurant opened in April&nbsp;2002 in a location formerly occupied by a
Redfish Seafood Grill and Bar restaurant in Cleveland, Ohio. The Cleveland
location&#146;s proximity to Jacobs Field, the home of the Cleveland Indians, and
the fact that Cleveland is the home of the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame, resulted
in our decision to convert the location into an Alice Cooper&#146;stown. Our Alice
Cooper&#146;stown restaurant is a full-service, casual dining establishment
featuring a wide selection of high-quality, freshly prepared popular foods and
beverages, including a number of innovative and distinctive menu items, such as
menu items that are sports and rock and roll themed.&#160; In addition, the restaurant sells sports and
rock and roll memorabilia. The restaurant features quick, efficient, and
friendly table service designed to minimize customer-waiting time and facilitate
table turnover.&#160; Our Alice Cooper&#146;stown
restaurant benefits significantly from the</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">6</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">name recognition of Alice Cooper and the
proximity to Jacobs Field, the home of the Cleveland Indians, and the Rock and

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:0in;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">Menu</font></i></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:0in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Our menu in Cleveland includes salads and sandwiches,
pizzas and burgers, and tempting appetizers and desserts.</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Menu prices range from $4 to $9 for appetizers and
desserts, $5 to $18 for entr&#233;es, and $6 to $11 for pizzas and burgers.</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:0in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:0in;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">Restaurant Layout and Staffing</font></i></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Our Alice Cooper&#146;stown restaurant was designed to
feature a rock and roll and sports theme, featuring the connection to rock and
roll legend Alice Cooper. The general d&#233;cor is rock and roll and sports
memorabilia. The logo reads &#147;Where Rock and Roll and Sports Collide&#148;. The
restaurant features a video wall in the bar and a large screen video in the
dining room. In keeping with its sports bar theme, there are more than 35 TV
screens in the restaurant. Some of our former Cleveland Redfish staff,
including management personnel, are involved in the operation of this
restaurant.</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:0in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:0in;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">Construction Economics</font></i></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:0in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Our construction costs to
convert this location were approximately $400,000, and pre-opening expenses
were approximately $191,000.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">Future Site Selection All
Concepts</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">When evaluating whether and where to seek expansion of
our restaurant operations, we analyze a restaurant&#146;s profit potential.&#160; We consider the location of a restaurant to
be one of the most critical elements of the restaurant&#146;s long-term
success.&#160; Accordingly, we expend
significant time and effort in investigating and evaluating potential
restaurant sites.&#160; In conducting the site
selection process, we obtain and examine detailed demographic information, such
as population characteristics, density, and household income levels; evaluate
site characteristics, such as visibility, accessibility, and traffic volume;
consider the proposed restaurant&#146;s proximity to demand generators, such as
shopping malls, lodging, and office complexes; and analyze potential competition.&#160; Our senior corporate management evaluates and
approves each restaurant site for all of our brands prior to acquisition after
extensive consultation with all levels of our operations group.&#160; TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. provides site selection
guidelines and criteria as well as site selection counseling and assistance for
our TGI Friday&#146;s restaurant sites.&#160; We
also must obtain TGI Friday&#146;s Inc.&#146;s consent before we enter into definitive
agreements for a TGI Friday&#146;s restaurant site.</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We have entered into an exclusive, renewable one-year
brokerage agreement with Staubach Retail Services-West, LLC, a nationally known
commercial brokerage company, to provide us with real estate and site selection
consulting services. The individual who managed our account left Staubach and
became associated with a commercial brokerage company headquartered in Phoenix,
Arizona.&#160; However,&#160; this individual will continue to manage our
account through Staubach.</font></p>

<br clear="all" style="page-break-before:always;">


<div>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">Restaurant Operations</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">TGI Friday&#146;s, Bamboo Club,
Redfish, and Alice Cooper&#146;stown Operations</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Once a restaurant is
integrated into our operations, we provide a variety of corporate services to
assure the operational success of the restaurant. Our executive management
continually monitors restaurant operations, inspects individual restaurants to
assure the quality of products and services and the maintenance of facilities,
institutes procedures to enhance efficiency and reduce costs, and provides
centralized support systems.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We also maintain quality
assurance procedures designed to assure compliance with the high quality of
products and services mandated by our company and, for our TGI Friday&#146;s
restaurants, by TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. We respond to and investigate inquiries and
complaints, initiate on-site resolution of deficiencies, and consult with each
restaurant&#146;s staff to assure that proper action is taken to correct any
deficiency.&#160; Our personnel, and the
third-party quality assurance professionals that we occasionally retain, make
unannounced visits to restaurants to evaluate the facilities, products, and
services.&#160; We believe that our quality
review program and executive oversight enhance restaurant operations, reduce
operating costs, improve customer satisfaction, and facilitate the highest level
of compliance with the TGI Friday&#146;s system.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We maintain a zero tolerance
policy for discrimination of any type towards both our employees and customers
and, to this end, constantly enforce this policy through our training of new
employees, our policy and training manuals, and periodic re-enforcement
programs.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Restaurant Management</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Our TGI Friday&#146;s regional and
restaurant management personnel are responsible for complying with TGI Friday&#146;s
Inc.&#146;s and our operational standards.&#160;
Our Executive Vice President of Operations is responsible for the
operation of all of our brands.&#160; In our
TGI Friday&#146;s and Redfish divisions, assisting our Executive Vice President, we
have a Vice President of Operations for TGI Friday&#146;s and Redfish restaurants.
Assisting this position we have two Senior Regional Managers and four Regional
Managers, who are each responsible for between eight and 11 of our restaurants
within their region.&#160; We have one
Director of Operations who is responsible for the Alice Cooper&#146;stown
restaurant. This individual has signed an agreement wherein he purchased a net
profit participation in this operation equal to 20% of a defined level of
profits over a certain earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and
amortization (EBITDA) as defined.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We have a Director of
Operations and two Regional Managers for the Bamboo Club &#147;Asian Bistro&#148;
restaurants, one responsible for six restaurants and one responsible for seven
restaurants in the manager&#146;s territory, who report to the Director of
Operations for Bamboo Club restaurants, who in turn reports to the Executive
Vice President of Operations.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Executive Vice President
of Operations reports to our CEO and President, who has the ultimate
responsibility for our TGI Friday&#146;s, Redfish, Bamboo Club, and Alice Cooper&#146;stown
operations.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Restaurant managers are
responsible for day-to-day restaurant operations, including customer relations,
food preparation and service, cost control, restaurant maintenance, and
personnel relations.&#160; We typically staff
our restaurants with an on-site general manager, two or three assistant
managers, and a kitchen manager. Our TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants average between 80
and 90 hourly employees.&#160; Our Redfish
restaurants average approximately 65 hourly employees and our Bamboo Club
restaurants average approximately 72 hourly employees. Our Alice Cooper&#146;stown
restaurant averages 50 hourly employees. We support these operational personnel
with personnel involved in financial planning, research and development, and
training.</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">11</font></p>

<div style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">

<hr size="2" width="100%" noshade color="gray" align="left">

</font></div>

</div>
<!-- SEQ.=1,FOLIO='11',FILE='C:\JMS\sshanka\05-1930-1\task335620\1930-1-ba-01.htm',USER='sesankaran',CD='Mar  8 00:34 2005' -->


<br clear="all" style="page-break-before:always;">


<div>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We have established a program
of appointing multi-location senior general managers in geographic areas having
locations close enough to each other to support this concept.&#160; We currently have seven multi-location senior
general managers. In addition to improving efficiency, this program allows us
to promote and compensate key general managers and create a position that
improves our ability to retain key employees in our company.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Recruitment and Training</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We attempt to hire employees
who are committed to the standards maintained by our company and, for our TGI
Friday&#146;s restaurants, by TGI Friday&#146;s Inc.&#160;
We also believe that our high unit sales volume, the image and
atmosphere of the TGI Friday&#146;s, Bamboo Club, Redfish, and Alice Cooper&#146;stown
concepts, and our career advancement and employee benefit programs enable us to
attract high quality management and restaurant personnel.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Our TGI Friday&#146;s restaurant personnel participate in
continuing training programs maintained by TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. and our
company.&#160; In addition, we supplement
those programs by hiring personnel devoted solely to employee training.&#160; Each TGI Friday&#146;s restaurant general and
assistant manager completes a formal training program conducted by our
company.&#160; This program provides our TGI
Friday&#146;s restaurant managers 14 weeks of training.&#160; The training covers all aspects of management
philosophy and overall restaurant operations, including supervisory skills,
operating and performance standards, accounting procedures, and employee
selection and training necessary for restaurant operations. We employ personnel
who are involved exclusively in training for both initial new store openings
and continued re-training.</font></p>

<p align="left" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:left;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Our Bamboo Club and Redfish
restaurant managers and personnel participate in extensive training programs
consistent with our operating standards.&#160;
Many of our Redfish restaurant managers are experienced TGI Friday&#146;s
managers who have accepted positions in our Redfish operations.&#160; We have implemented all of our policies and
training programs in order to operate the Alice Cooper&#146;stown restaurant with
the same high standards we have established for our other brands.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Maintenance and Improvement of
Restaurants</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We maintain our restaurants
and all associated fixtures, furnishings, and equipment in conformity with the
TGI Friday&#146;s system or standards we have developed for our Bamboo Club and Redfish
restaurants.&#160; We also make necessary
additions, alterations, repairs, and replacements to our TGI Friday&#146;s
restaurants as required by TGI Friday&#146;s Inc., including periodic repainting or
replacement of obsolete signs, furnishings, equipment, and decor. &#160;We are required, subject to certain
limitations, to modernize our restaurants to the now current standards and
specifications reflected in its new prototype design of TGI Friday&#146;s Inc.&#160; In the past few years, we have developed a
plan that we refer to as a &#147;pop out&#148; in four of our existing TGI Friday&#146;s
restaurants that expands the restaurants by approximately 950 to 1,200 square
feet. In 2004, we completed a major renovation in our San Diego (Mission
Valley), California, and commenced a renovation in our Palm Desert, California
TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants and will complete additional renovations in 2005.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We have developed plans to
construct improvements for some of our TGI Friday&#146;s locations to develop a
take-out program, which program could be used in the future with our other
brands.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#160;We are developing a standard prototype that we
plan to use on future Bamboo Club restaurants.&#160;
Our Desert Ridge (Phoenix, AZ) location was our first fully
free-standing Bamboo Club restaurant.</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<div>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Information Systems</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We have devoted considerable
resources to develop and implement management information systems that improve
the quality and flow of information throughout our company.&#160; We use five to seven touch-screen computer
registers (point of sale terminals) located conveniently throughout each of our
restaurants.&#160; Servers enter guest orders
by touching the appropriate sections of the register&#146;s computer screen, which
transfers the information electronically to the kitchen and bar for
preparation.&#160; These registers also are
connected to a computer in the restaurant office and to our corporate
information system by frame relay.&#160;
Management receives detailed comparative reports on each restaurant&#146;s
sales and expense performance daily, weekly, and monthly.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#160; During 2004, we completed the installation of
the Aloha Technologies Point of Sales System (POS) and back office systems at
all of our restaurants and implemented a new Human Resources and Payroll system
using the Lawson ERP system.&#160; Our
conversion to the new ERP system for our financial modules (including general
ledger, accounts payable, and fixed assets) began in late 2004. We anticipate
the ERP implementation will be completed by the middle of 2005. Hosting and
support of the new corporate ERP system has been outsourced to netASPx, Inc.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We
are in the process of converting the data connection of our restaurants from a
frame-relay technology to an Internet-based technology allowing us, among other
things, to have a more stream-lined technology communication process including
more productive bandwidth and higher speed capacity.&#160; We expect this will more than double the
speed of our up and down path of information, enabling more efficient support,
quicker communication, faster email access, less down time, and an overall
savings as it relates to less time our restaurant managers spend &#147;in the office&#148;.&#160; We recently completed our test phase and are
currently in the process of rolling out this new technology to all
restaurants.&#160; We expect this project to
be completed by the end of our second quarter 2005.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We believe that our management
information systems enable us to increase the speed and accuracy of order
taking and pricing, better assist guest preferences, efficiently schedule&nbsp;labor
to better serve guests, quickly and accurately monitor food and labor costs,
assist in product purchasing and product movement analysis, to promptly access
financial and operating data, and improve the accuracy and efficiency of
store-level information and reporting.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Supply, Purchasing, and
Distribution</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We purchase or lease, on a
short-term basis, all fixtures, furnishings, equipment, signs, recorded music,
food products, supplies, inventory, and other products and materials required
for the development and operation of our TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants from
suppliers approved by TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. In order to be approved as a supplier,
a prospective supplier must demonstrate to the reasonable satisfaction of TGI
Friday&#146;s Inc. its ability to meet the then-current standards and specifications
of TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. for such items, possess adequate quality controls, and
have the capacity to provide supplies promptly and reliably.&#160; We are not required to purchase supplies from
any specified suppliers, but the purchase or lease of any items from an
unapproved supplier requires the prior approval of TGI Friday&#146;s Inc.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. maintains a
list of approved suppliers and a set of the TGI Friday&#146;s system standards and
specifications.&#160; TGI Friday&#146;s Inc.
receives no commissions on direct sales to its franchisees, but may receive
rebates and promotional discounts from manufacturers and suppliers, some of
which are passed on proportionately to our company.&#160; TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. is an approved supplier of
various kitchen equipment and store fixtures, decorative memorabilia, and
various paper goods, such as menus and in-store advertising materials and
items.&#160; We are not, however, required to
purchase such items from TGI Friday&#146;s Inc.&#160;
If we elect to purchase such items from TGI Friday&#146;s Inc., TGI Friday&#146;s
Inc. may derive revenue as a result of such purchases.</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We have an agreement with U.S.
Foodservice, a national food distribution service company, to serve
substantially all of our TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants in California, Arizona, and
Nevada and for all of our Bamboo Club and Redfish restaurants. We have an
agreement with Performance Food Group in Missouri, Kansas, and New Mexico for
all of our TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants located in those states.&#160; Orders are sent electronically to the
supplier.&#160; Our suppliers have
comprehensive warehouse and delivery outlets servicing each of our markets. We
believe that our purchases from our primary suppliers enable us to maintain a
high level of quality, achieve dependability in the receipt of our supplies,
avoid the costs of maintaining a large purchasing department, and attain cost
advantages as the result of volume purchases. We believe, however, that all
essential products are available from other national suppliers as well as from
local suppliers in the cities in which our restaurants are located in the event
we determine to purchase our supplies from other suppliers.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">Advertising and Marketing</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">TGI Friday&#146;s Restaurants</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We participate in the national
marketing and advertising programs conducted by TGI Friday&#146;s Inc.&#160; The programs use network and cable television
and national publications and feature new menu innovations and various
promotional programs.&#160; In addition, from
time to time, we supplement the marketing and advertising programs conducted by
TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. through local radio, newspaper, and magazine advertising
media and sponsorship of community events.&#160;
In conjunction with TGI Friday&#146;s Inc., we maintain a &#147;frequent diner&#148;
program that includes awards of food, merchandise, and travel to frequent
diners based upon points accumulated through purchases.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">As a franchisee of TGI Friday&#146;s
Inc., we are able to utilize the trade names, service marks, trademarks,
emblems, and indicia of origin of TGI Friday&#146;s Inc., including the marks TGI
Friday&#146;s&#174; and Friday&#146;s&#174;.&#160; We advertise in
various media utilizing these marks to attract new customers to our
restaurants.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Each franchise agreement also
requires us to spend at least 4% of gross sales on local marketing and to
contribute to a national marketing pool which is administered by TGI Friday&#146;s
Inc.&#160; The national marketing pool funds
are used to develop national advertising campaigns (creative material) and buy
national, spot, and local advertising.&#160;
All funds contributed to the national advertising fund are credited
against the local advertising requirement.&#160;
TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. required us, as well as all other franchisees, to
contribute to a marketing fund. The marketing fund contributions were 2.7%,
3.25%, and 3.5% in 2002, 2003, and 2004 respectively.&#160; TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. has increased the marketing
fund contributions to 4.0% for 2005.&#160;
Marketing fund contributions totaled $6,573,000 during fiscal 2004,
$6,153,000 during fiscal 2003, and $5,250,000 during fiscal 2002.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Bamboo Club and Redfish
Restaurants</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Our in-house marketing
department develops advertising and marketing programs for our Bamboo Club and
Redfish restaurants.&#160; We develop these
programs with an emphasis on building awareness of the &#147;Bamboo Club&#148; and &#147;Redfish&#148;
brands in the communities in which we operate Bamboo Club and Redfish
restaurants and generate sales for those restaurants.&#160; Advertising and marketing campaigns have
included radio and print advertising, as well as point-of-sale marketing
promotions.&#160; We conduct a comprehensive
advertising and public relations campaign in advance of each Bamboo Club and
Redfish restaurant grand opening.</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="background:white;margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="background:white;margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">New Restaurant Openings in 2005</font></i></b></p>

<p style="background:white;margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="background:white;margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Pursuant to our development
agreement with TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. we expect to open three to four new locations
in 2005. Our location in Surprise, Arizona (Northwest Phoenix area) will open
in the first half of 2005 and the remaining two to three are expected to open
in the second half of 2005.</font></p>

<p style="background:white;margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="background:white;margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We
currently are considering other sites for additional restaurants, but have not
entered into leases or purchase agreements for such sites.&#160; We do not know how many sites will
materialize, as that depends on a variety of factors and economic conditions.</font></p>

<p style="background:white;margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The opening of new restaurants
also may be affected by increased construction, utility, and labor costs,
delays resulting from governmental regulatory approvals, strikes, or work
stoppages, adverse weather conditions, and acts of God.&#160; Newly opened restaurants may operate at a
loss for a period following their opening.&#160;
The length of this period will depend upon a number of factors,
including the time of year the restaurant is opened, sales volume, and
operating costs.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">There can be no assurance that
we will be successful in achieving our expansion goals through the development
or acquisition of additional restaurants or that any additional restaurants
that are</font></p>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;">

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">developed or acquired will be
profitable.&#160; In addition, the opening of
additional restaurants in an existing market may have the effect of drawing
customers from, and reducing the sales volume of, our existing restaurants in
those markets.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">Restaurant Closures and Lease
Terminations</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="background:white;margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Generally when we close a
location due to underperformance or other reasons that management deems
appropriate, our first priority is to transfer useable assets to other
locations.&#160; Other assets that are not
transferable, including leasehold improvements and certain kitchen equipment,
are written off at the time of closure, or when the formal decision to close or
not renew the lease is made.&#160; At the time
of closure, allocated goodwill is also written off.</font></p>

<p style="background:white;margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">Development Agreements</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We are a party to two
development agreements entered into in early 2004 with TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. one
covering Southern California and the other covering Arizona, Nevada, and New
Mexico. Our new 2004 development agreements obligate us to open at least 16 new
TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants through 2009. In the past, we were unable to meet the
terms of development agreements with TGI Friday&#146;s Inc.&#160; In each instance, TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. waived
our non-compliance. Each development agreement grants us the right to develop
additional TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants in a specified territory and obligates us
to develop additional TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants in that territory in accordance
with a specified development schedule.&#160;
We own the exclusive rights to develop additional TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants
in territories encompassing the southern portion of California, and most of the
counties in the states of Arizona, Nevada, New Mexico and El Paso, Texas. We
plan to develop additional TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants in our existing development
territories.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-size:10.0pt;margin:0in 0in .0001pt 45.0pt;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">(1)</font><font size="1" style="font-size:8.5pt;">&#160;&#160; </font>Consists of Southern California. Agreement
expires at the end of 2009.</p>

<p style="font-size:10.0pt;margin:0in 0in .0001pt 45.0pt;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">(2)</font><font size="1" style="font-size:8.5pt;">&#160;&#160; </font>Consists of the states of Arizona and Nevada, and
most of the state of New Mexico and El Paso, Texas.&#160; Agreement expires at end of 2009.</p>

<p style="font-size:10.0pt;margin:0in 0in .0001pt 45.0pt;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">(3)</font><font size="1" style="font-size:8.5pt;">&#160;&#160; </font>Former development territory consisting of
metropolitan Kansas City, Kansas and Kansas City, Missouri.&#160; Agreement terminated in first quarter of
2004.</p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt 45.0pt;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Each development agreement
gives TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. certain remedies in the event that we fail to comply in
a timely manner with our schedule&nbsp;for restaurant development, if we
otherwise default under the development agreement or any franchise agreement
relating to a restaurant within that development territory as described above,
or if our officers or directors breach the confidentiality or non-compete</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">16</font></p>

<div style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">

<hr size="2" width="100%" noshade color="gray" align="left">

<br clear="all" style="page-break-before:always;">


<div>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">provisions of the development agreement.&#160; The remedies available to TGI Friday&#146;s Inc.
include (a) the termination of our exclusive right to develop restaurants in
the related territory; and (b) the termination of the development agreement.&#160; None of these remedies would adversely affect
our ability to continue to operate our then-existing TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">In 2004, we entered into a Development Incentive
agreement with TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. that provides royalty and development cost relief
for our California operations, if certain conditions and development performances
are met. The amount of such cost relief in 2004 was not material to our
financial results.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">TGI Friday&#146;s Restaurant Re image
and Improvement Program</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. has
developed specific plans and prototype examples of a restaurant remodel and
improvement program to enhance the restaurants and brand&#146;s overall appeal and
position in the marketplace. TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. has required franchisees to
remodel each location as soon as financially practicable.&#160; The cost of remodeling a location can vary
greatly, from $150,000 to $600,000, depending on numerous factors, including
the age and state of repair of the restaurant, local construction code requirements
and changes, the possibility of additional expansion of existing facilities,
and compliance with such laws as the Americans with Disabilities Act.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We believe we have 50
restaurants that will require remodeling to one degree or another and have
scheduled to complete three in 2005.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">Franchise Agreements</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We enter into or assume a
separate franchise agreement with respect to each TGI Friday&#146;s restaurant that
we acquire or develop pursuant to a development agreement.&#160; Each franchise agreement grants us an
exclusive license to operate a TGI Friday&#146;s restaurant within a designated
geographic area, which generally is a three-mile radius from each restaurant,
and obligates us to operate such restaurant in accordance with the requirements
and specifications established by TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. relating to food
preparation and quality of service as well as general operating procedures,
advertising, records maintenance, and protection of trademarks.&#160; The franchise agreements restrict our ability
to transfer our interest in our TGI Friday&#146;s restaurants without the consent of
TGI Friday&#146;s Inc.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Each franchise agreement
requires us to pay TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. an initial franchise fee of $50,000. We
currently have entered into an agreement with TGI Friday&#146;s Inc. where we only
pay $25,000 for new Southern California franchises, which agreement has a term
equal to the Southern California Development Agreement.&#160; In addition, we are obligated to pay TGI
Friday&#146;s Inc. a royalty of generally 4% of gross revenue as defined in the
franchise agreement for each restaurant, although we have entered into a
California Development Incentive Agreement which will reduce a portion of these
fees. Royalty expense under these agreements totaled $7,172,000 during fiscal
2004, $7,510,000 during fiscal 2003, and $7,477,000 during fiscal 2002.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">As previously discussed, each
franchise agreement also requires us to spend at least 4% of gross sales on
local marketing and to contribute to a national marketing pool that is
administered by TGI Friday&#146;s Inc.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-indent:.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">A default under one of our
franchise agreements will not constitute a default under any of our other
franchise agreements.&#160; A default under
the franchise agreement for a restaurant in a development territory may,
however, constitute a default under the development agreement for that
development territory.</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">17</font></p>
